subject.title: chore(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Are the failed local-auth Playwright runs and Vercel deployment unrelated base or infrastructure failures, or must this dependency group be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The diff has no identifiable line-level defect and most gates pass, but only a maintainer with access to the failed-run diagnostics can safely accept the grouped production compatibility risk.

options.title: Rerun and classify the failures
options.body: Rerun the failed browser and deployment gates on this exact head, then merge only if they pass or match confirmed base/infrastructure failures.

options.title: Split the dependency group
options.body: Recreate narrower updates if a failure reproduces only with this head so the responsible package can be isolated.

options.title: Accept the grouped risk
options.body: Merge with the failed runtime checks only if maintainers explicitly own the possibility of a production or authenticated-flow regression.

recommendation.title: Rerun and classify the failures
recommendation.body: Rerun the failed browser and deployment gates on this exact head, then merge only if they pass or match confirmed base/infrastructure failures.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows repeated integration and CI ownership, making this person the best available candidate to classify the failed gates.
